featured_reviews.name: AK
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wonderful hospital overall, and Dr. Patil is fantastic. My wife had a normal delivery, and throughout labor they continuously monitored the baby's heart rate, which gave us confidence that both mother and baby were safe.

The reason I am giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that the baby was repeatedly taken away from us for bathing, blood tests, vaccinations, and other routine procedures. While I understand these procedures are necessary, as a new and somewhat anxious family, it was not a pleasant feeling to have our newborn taken to a separate room without being able to see what was happening. Some hospitals have a glass viewing area or perform these procedures in front of the parents, which provides additional reassurance.

Another area for improvement would be post-delivery guidance. As first-time parents, we would have appreciated more practical demonstrations, such as how to bathe and handle the baby at home.

That said, the staff were very kind, helpful, and friendly throughout our stay. Overall, we had a positive experience and would highly recommend Dr. Patil and the hospital. We would definitely consider coming back here if we were blessed with a second child in the future.

From admission formalities to discharge papers, everything was smooth, systematic and stress-free.

I had a very disappointing and frustrating experience with Dr. Rohini Patil. After consulting her for 8 months, I expected proper guidance and care, but unfortunately, I felt misled and neglected. Throughout the treatment, there was a lack of clear advice and professional ethics.

After months of consultation, I was suddenly informed that the patient’s blood levels were too low and SGOT/SGPT levels were elevated. Instead of guiding us properly, she referred us to her husband. I had already done a full blood test on my own, but they refused to consider it because it wasn’t from their preferred lab. When the same tests were repeated through their diagnostic center, the results were exactly the same — yet they demanded ₹90,000 for surgery and insisted on paying ₹60,000 upfront just to begin the procedure.

When I mentioned taking a second opinion, as advised by a friend, they got upset and defensive. They even wrote in the file that if anything happened to the patient, it would be entirely our responsibility — which felt like emotional blackmail. It seemed more like a money-making tactic than genuine medical care.

Thankfully, I followed my friend’s advice and consulted a good, ethical doctor — and I’m happy to share that the delivery was successful and both mother and baby are completely healthy. This only proves how important it is to be cautious and not blindly trust any doctor.

I would never recommend Dr. Rohini Patil. Healthcare is about trust, compassion, and responsibility — qualities that were completely missing in this experience. Be very careful when choosing a doctor.
